# CHOCOLATE, VIENNA STYLE

## Ingredients

- four ounces of Walter Baker & Co.'s Vanilla Chocolate
- one quart of milk
- three tablespoonfuls of hot water
- one tablespoonful of sugar

## Instructions

1. Cut the chocolate in fine bits.
2. Put the milk on the stove in the double-boiler, and when it has been heated to the boiling point, put the chocolate, sugar and water in a small iron or granite-ware pan, and stir over a hot fire until smooth and glossy.
3. Stir this mixture into the hot milk, and beat well with a whisk.
4. Serve at once, putting a tablespoonful of whipped cream in each cup and then filling up with the chocolate.

## Notes

The plain chocolate may be used instead of the vanilla, but in that case use a teaspoonful of vanilla extract and three generous tablespoonfuls of sugar instead of one.
